'''Vondrol''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Meastrinnar]] and a sister city to the similarly-named [[Vondrel]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an insurgency against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took root and a group of [[Spy/Legends|spies]] affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] used Vondrol as a base of operations. In response to the rebellion on Meastrinnar, the Empire undertook a [[Pacification of Meastrinnar|pacification]] campaign and the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] eventually discovered the cell. A squad of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] led by [[Vin Northal/Legends|Vin Northal]] was assigned to eliminate the cell, but the ISB transmission had been decoded incorrectly and they mistakenly attacked an orphanage in Vondrel instead, an action that resulted in the deaths of dozens of sleeping children.
